description: Token-skipping can pass a noncontiguous state view to a stride-unaware histogram kernel.
trigger: Multiple state rows, positive skip_tokens smaller than the context length, and state already on the selected device so no copying materializes the slice.
expected_behavior: Histogram every element of the selected token suffixes.
actual_behavior: inspect_state does not make the slice contiguous. The native kernel traverses input_ptr[0:numel], ignoring row gaps, so it can include skipped tokens from later rows and omit selected trailing tokens.

verification.description: The parent has no inspect_state caller; the new main calls it after each module forward. Traced its slice through histogram to raw-pointer CUDA indexing.
verification.limits: Conditional on the view retaining row strides; device-copy behavior was not executed.

verification.description: Modeled a contiguous [2,3,2] tensor with one skipped token per row: selected values sum to 52, whereas contiguous pointer traversal from the slice offset sums to 44.
verification.limits: Python indexing model, not Torch or CUDA execution.
